ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.1S4-CD1 CustomSet A/B Trace is a diagnostic-only build based directly on S4 Tail Rescue. S4 behavior remains unchanged for ordinary calls. Once a JobGiver Work JobPackage has already exceeded 32ms, CD1 samples custom IEnumerable Thing searches: one out of every 32 eligible calls is forced through live Vanilla ClosestThingReachable, and an offset one out of every 32 is measured on the existing S4 custom fast path. The sampled calls are grouped into 16-31, 32-63, 64-127 and 128+ observed source-size buckets and record elapsed time, no-result rate, RegionTraverser calls and Reachability.CanReach calls. This build intentionally adds diagnostic Harmony hooks and must not be judged by its overall JobGiver average. Use the CD1 supplemental report to decide whether small tail custom sets are actually faster on S4 or Vanilla.
